- [TS3009a:20:11] Specific ideas as to components and materials are to be left to the next meeting.
- [TS3009a:22:12] They will look further at the idea of covers in the mext meeting too.
- [TS3009b:11:15] The solution to complaints about remote controls being difficult to learn is to focus on an intuitive design instead of a thorough manual.
- [TS3009b:22:34] The idea of interchangeable fronts was mentioned again; if it were adopted, the company should be recognisable in all the available fronts as well as the remote itself.
- [TS3009b:21:40] The team agreed to follow a user-centred approach and simplify the design by somehow minimising the number of buttons.
- [TS3009b:27:24] An LCD screen is going to be used to display information, but would not be interactive. (replaces a remote without a screen)
- [TS3009b:31:26] The buttons are going to include: OK, menu, screen sizing, AV, settings buttons, mute, digits 1-9, power, volume control, channel up/down.
- [TS3009b:35:35] There is no need for a special button to recognise two-digit numbers.
- [TS3009b:37:33] The less frequently used buttons will not be hidden under a flip, as it had been previously suggested, as there are not that many of them; they will just be clearly separated from the more important ones.
- [TS3009c:07:08] The push buttons are going to be made of rubber.
- [TS3009c:05:20] Making changeable fascias can allow for the integration of this or future fashion trends in the device.
- [TS3009c:17:13] The team agreed to place the LCD at the bottom of the device, below the buttons.
- [TS3009c:14:52] TV settings will be included in menus there instead of having separate buttons for them.
- [TS3009c:30:01] They will implement speech recognition as well, because their target group like such gimmicks.
- [TS3009c:24:59] The case will be titanium with a plastic front with rounded buttons.
- [TS3009c:36:33] Parts of the front (like the bottom where the LCD is and the top corner where the logo is) will also be titanium.
- [TS3009c:26:39] The chip is going to be a standard one. (replaces an advanced chip)
- [TS3009c:27:36] They will launch the product with various fronts to choose from including a couple of basic colours or fruit and vegetable themes to go with the current fashion.
- [TS3009c:34:36] The logo will be both at the front and the back of the remote; the company slogan will be engraved at the back.
